notes.title: Level editor tutorial
notes.content: Added a tutorial to the level editor. Also available here: [previewyoutube=WmOQwJ997u8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Minor fix
notes.content:
Added zoom functionality to level editor
Fixed issue with saving level

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
Due to the engine updates the game was scaled up to be x4 (otherwise collision model didn't work).

Please expect bugs and report them in the bug report sections.
Saved replays are not functioning too, I'll fix them soon.
Fixed unbeatable levels on "ultra hard" difficulty, fixed few timings.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content: Fixed goal time for a few levels

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content:
- Sporadic bug on beach boss.
- Game completion bug not showing cutscenes properly.
- Old saves conflict.
- Key rebinding bug fixed and overall behavior is improved.

notes.title: Archievements and tracking
notes.content:
Achievements are finally here! Track your progress, discover hidden goals and more!

Other updates:
[list]
[*] Added a tracker showing how many other players have completed the level.
[*] Revorked beach boss level keys aspect to reduce the anger a little :D
[*] Small update on the other player's ghost's appearance.
[*] Added an indicator to the castle boss spheres.
[*] Tons of large and small bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes and improvements.
notes.content:
Few bugfixes and improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed crash on the Castle step level 2.
[*] Added a death sound for other player ghosts.
[*] Added color coding for other player's ghosts.
[*] Fixed shield effect not appearing.
[*] Removed a fake keys rotation on the beach boss level to better detect the correct key.
[/list]
